name: My Teacher Friend
source:
My Teacher Friend is a visual novel that takes place at a high school and follows a protagonist that starts his 9th grade. The protagonist can have a name of your choice. Fuji, one of the main characters of the story, is a person that can only be seen by the protagonist. He strives to help the protagonist in any way possible to get him through this part of life.

[From [url=https://fujiyamathebuffsamoyed.itch.io/my-teacher-friend]Itch.io[/url]]
